thread:
Priya: FYI saw 3 models slipped past lint and failed in runtime because their tokenizer IDs overlay a portion of the embedding table (vocab overlay). They map ids 0-999 to special tokens but model embedding starts at 500, so lookup garbles.

Tom: ouch. That's a nasty overlay. Our current checks only validate declared_vocab_size against embedding_size but don't detect id-space remapping.

Liam: idea: add a 'vocab_overlay' preflight that inspects tokenizer->id min/max and any reserved id ranges, then crosswalks against the model's embedding index offset. If overlap > 0, mark FAIL.

Priya: we need to be careful about models that intentionally shard embeddings or use offset encodings. Add metadata field 'embedding_index_offset' and 'vocab_overlay_policy' so authors can declare nonstandard layouts.

Tom: tradeoffs: deepbench can detect this, but costs time. Preflight should be cheap and deterministic. Running a few header inspections is O(1) and <50ms. So do it sync in intake.

Liam: propose rules: compute overlap_count = max(0, min(token_max, emb_offset+emb_size-1) - max(token_min, emb_offset) +1). If overlap_count > 0 -> FAIL unless metadata.vocab_overlay_policy == "allow". Emit metric overlay_pct = overlap_count / emb_size.

Priya: default policy should be DENY. Require explicit owner signoff for allow. For "allow" we still schedule deepbench but do not block fastpath. Also record a human-readable note on model page.

Tom: also consider sparse embeddings where only subset indices used. Hard to infer reliably. Add a flag 'embedding_sparsity_hint' optionally provided by packagers. If present relax checks but still surface a warning.

Liam: implementation plan: 1) intake reads tokenizer.json and model manifest, 2) run vocab-crosswalk check, 3) write metadata keys: vocab_min, vocab_max, embedding_index_offset, vocab_overlay_policy, overlay_count, overlay_pct. 4) route based on result: PASS/WARN/FAIL.

Priya: for routing defaults: PASS -> fastpath, WARN -> fastpath + schedule deepbench async, FAIL -> block and create deepbench ticket with probe output and suggested remediation (shift IDs or set embedding_offset).

QA-bot: regression test added: sample model with tokenizer ids 400-1400 and embedding offset 500, size 512 -> expected overlay_count = 412, overlay_pct ~= 0.804.

Tom: nice. Also add console UI hint: clickable "show crosswalk" that prints token id ranges and embedding index map. Useful for debugging customer reports.

Priya: owners: Liam will land the crosswalk check + unit tests, Tom will add registry fields and UI hint, I'll write runbook describing remediation steps and signoff process.

Liam: will also add a small CLI to simulate:

```
# simulate overlay
python infra/vocab_crosswalk.py --tokenizer ./tk.json --manifest ./model.json --out /tmp/crosswalk.json
jq . /tmp/crosswalk.json
```

Priya: keep the sync check sub-50ms; anything longer -> treat as WARN and schedule background verification.

ingest-bot: vocab-crosswalk check enqueued (job id vc-8271) on worker-9 :gear:

Priya: thanks team, will track in RFC follow-up. :thumbsup:
